pairs.question: Num enim alia in causa M. Cato fuit, alia ceteri, qui se in Africa Caesari tradiderunt?
pairs.answer: Atqui ceteris forsitan vitio datum esset, si se interemissent, propterea quod lenior eorum vita et mores fuerant faciliores; Catoni cum incredibilem tribuisset natura gravitatem, eamque ipse perpetua constantia roboravisset semperque in proposito susceptoque consilio permansisset, moriendum potius quam tyranni vultus aspiciendus fuit.
pairs.derivation: Authorial rhetorical question (num) whether Cato's case differed from the others who surrendered to Caesar in Africa, answered substantively by Cicero himself. Answer begins at 'atqui' (capitalized) and runs to the full stop, explaining that the cases did differ: suicide would have been a fault for the others but death was right for Cato.
